SQL:
WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    regions.name AS "customers.regions.name",
    COUNT(*) AS "customers.customers",
    CAST(SUM(customers.credit) AS DOUBLE) AS "customers.credit_sum"
  FROM customers AS customers
  LEFT JOIN regions AS regions
    ON customers.region_id = regions.id
  GROUP BY
    regions.name
), _cm_customers__orders__id_count AS (
  SELECT
    customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
    COUNT(orders.id) AS "orders.id_count"
  FROM orders AS orders
  LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
    ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
  LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
    ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
  GROUP BY
    customers__regions.name
)
SELECT
  _base."customers.regions.name",
  _base."customers.customers",
  _base."customers.credit_sum",
  COALESCE(_cm_customers__orders__id_count."orders.id_count", 0) AS "customers.orders"
FROM _base
LEFT JOIN _cm_customers__orders__id_count
  ON _base."customers.regions.name" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_customers__orders__id_count."orders.customers.regions.name"
ORDER BY
  _base."customers.regions.name" ASC
LIMIT 21
